instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the trading bot UI in Spanish ('Bot en Ejecución', 'Detenido', 'Posiciones Abiertas', 'Historial de Trades', 'Evaluación de IA Claude', etc.).
Default to dark mode styling with crisp #1E293B hairline borders and #07090E background.
Do NOT useSpace Grotesk or Inter for headings. Use Outfit for headings and IBM Plex Mono for all numerical data.
Do NOT use #1B93A4 (teal). Use emerald-500 for bullish/long and rose-500 for bearish/short, amber-500 for Bybit/paper indicators, purple-500 for Claude AI features.
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, switches, selects, inputs, table rows) have unambiguous data-testid attributes.
Connect to the FastAPI backend endpoints for starting/stopping bot, fetching live ticker prices, viewing positions, updating risk parameters, evaluating AI signals, and resetting paper balance.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md).
DO NOT apply universal transition 'transition: all'. Add specific transitions for interactive elements.
Do NOT center align the app container text.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide SVG icons instead.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
